blocks.text: A haunted refrigerator, a creature lurking in the bathroom, and a terrifying train ride. For generations of Filipinos, Shake, Rattle & Roll made even the most ordinary places frightening, leaving behind horror stories that became part of childhood memories and Filipino pop culture. More than four decades later, those familiar scares are finding another home as Regal Entertainment and BingoPlus bring the beloved horror franchise into interactive digital gaming. The partnership brings together Regal’s legacy in Filipino filmmaking and BingoPlus’ digital entertainment platform, introducing five original games inspired by the franchise: Manananggal, Reyna Ahas, Triple Terror, LRT Monster, and Aswang.
